scripts.title: Aimbot Template
scripts.author: template
scripts.description: Minimal FOV + closest-player aimbot scaffold. Edit to taste.
scripts.source:
-- Aimbot template
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local Cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local cfg = { fov = 90, key = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 }

local function nearest()
    local best, bestDist
    local me = Players.LocalPlayer
    local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        if p ~= me and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('Head') then
            local pos, onScreen = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(p.Character.Head.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local d = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - mouse).Magnitude
                if d < cfg.fov and (not bestDist or d < bestDist) then
                    best, bestDist = p.Character.Head, d
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(cfg.key) then
        local t = nearest()
        if t then Cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, t.Position) end
    end
end)

scripts.title: ESP Template
scripts.author: template
scripts.description: Billboard-based player ESP: names, healthbar, distance. No internal drawing API needed.
scripts.source:
-- ESP template using BillboardGui (works on any UNC-compliant exec)
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local esp = {}

local function add(plr)
    if plr == Players.LocalPlayer then return end
    local function hook(char)
        local head = char:WaitForChild('Head', 5); if not head then return end
        local bb = Instance.new('BillboardGui')
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 40)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.Parent = head
        local tl = Instance.new('TextLabel', bb)
        tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
        tl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
        tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        tl.Text = plr.Name
        esp[plr] = bb
    end
    if plr.Character then hook(plr.Character) end
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(hook)
end

for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do add(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(add)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
    if esp[p] then esp[p]:Destroy(); esp[p] = nil end
end)

scripts.title: FPS Counter
scripts.author: template
scripts.description: Simple top-right FPS display using RunService.Heartbeat sampling.
scripts.source:
local RS = game:GetService('RunService')
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')

local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui', pg)
gui.Name = 'krnlexec_fps'; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
local tl = Instance.new('TextLabel', gui)
tl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 24)
tl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 10)
tl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
tl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
tl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
tl.Text = '...'

local n, acc = 0, 0
RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    acc += dt; n += 1
    if acc >= 0.25 then
        tl.Text = string.format('%d fps', math.floor(n/acc + 0.5))
        n, acc = 0, 0
    end
end)
